rows.grounds: mantra name for the syllable om
ritual body parts or mantra limbs

items.question: Which mantra element functions as the key before the limbs are ritually placed?
premises: The praṇava is designated as the kīlaka.
The limbs are to be placed after this designation.
The instruction is addressed directly to the goddess.
items.inference: After assigning the praṇava as the key, the practitioner should ritually place the limbs.
uncertainties: The specific set of aṅgāni intended is not named in this verse.
items.plain_english: O goddess, then one should set the praṇava as the key and place the limbs.
